WITH assessment_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    f.fac_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.ab_key) as total_assessments,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(asr.suic_risk) = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as high_risk_count
  FROM facilities f
  JOIN clinicians c ON f.fac_key = c.fac_connect
  JOIN patients p ON c.clin_key = p.clin_lead_ref
  JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON p.pat_key = ab.pat_owner_ref
  JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk asr ON ab.ab_key = asr.asr_key
  GROUP BY f.fac_key
),
srp_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    fac_key,
    CASE WHEN total_assessments > 0 
      THEN (high_risk_count::numeric / total_assessments) * 100 
      ELSE 0 
    END as srp
  FROM assessment_counts
),
pfis_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    f.fac_key,
    AVG(
      CASE 
        WHEN LOWER(asd.func_imp) = 'severe' THEN 3
        WHEN LOWER(asd.func_imp) = 'moderate' THEN 2
        WHEN LOWER(asd.func_imp) = 'mild' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) as pfis
  FROM facilities f
  JOIN clinicians c ON f.fac_key = c.fac_connect
  JOIN patients p ON c.clin_key = p.clin_lead_ref
  JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON p.pat_key = ab.pat_owner_ref
  JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON ab.ab_key = asd.asd_key
  GROUP BY f.fac_key
),
frai_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    fac_key,
    AVG(
      CASE 
        WHEN LOWER(com_res) IN ('comprehensive', 'extensive') THEN 3
        WHEN LOWER(com_res) = 'adequate' THEN 2
        WHEN LOWER(com_res) = 'limited' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) as frai
  FROM facilities
  GROUP BY fac_key
)
SELECT 
  s.fac_key,
  ROUND(CAST(p.pfis AS numeric), 2) as pfis,
  ROUND(CAST(f.frai AS numeric), 2) as frai,
  ROUND(CAST((p.pfis - f.frai) AS numeric), 2) as rdd
FROM srp_calc s
JOIN pfis_calc p ON s.fac_key = p.fac_key
JOIN frai_calc f ON s.fac_key = f.fac_key
WHERE s.srp > 20
ORDER BY rdd DESC
